associations.rationale: The type defines the algebraic-integer object as a bundled subalgebra of the complex numbers over the integers.
The type defines the algebraic-number object as a bundled intermediate field of the complex numbers over the rationals.
This membership characterization supports the bundled algebraic-integer object but is not itself the claim that the object represents Z-bar.
This membership characterization supports the bundled algebraic-number object but is not itself the claim that the object represents Q-bar.
